name: Fey Healing, Lesser
body:
School transmutation (healing); Level bloodrager 1, druid 1, magus 1, ranger 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, summoner 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (1 drop of blood from a fey creature)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target living or undead creature touched
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 5)
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You anoint the target with the blood of a fey creature, using the inherent magic properties to grant fast healing 1 for the duration. Lesser fey healing does not heal damage dealt by cold iron or lawful-aligned weapons, or spells or effects with the law descriptor. If the target takes such damage during the duration, the spell immediately ends. The target detects as a chaotically-aligned creature and as a fey type creature for the duration of the spell but is not treated as fey or chaotically-aligned for any other purpose.

Multiple fey healing spells or other spells that grant fast healing do not stack. Only the spell that heals the most damage is applied.
